claims.text: The experiment used a dataset of 451 news articles from 48 news outlets, both propagandistic and non-propagandistic, annotated by professionals according to eighteen persuasion techniques.
The articles were annotated based on their use of specific propaganda techniques, with a total of 7,485 instances identified across the dataset.
